description: Apply the Disengage duplicate-economy fix at the action-economy hook boundary selected by the certified corridor after the compiler rejected the transaction implementation file.
planning_goal: For a committed full.disengage action, runActionEconomyPreValidationHook must recognize when its prepared action-economy snapshot already contains a matching unexecuted Turn action. In that case, retain and validate the prepared request using the existing ignoreActionCost mechanism so the already-recorded Full Action does not block effect execution or get consumed again. If there is no matching committed action, preserve the prepared request and ordinary action-economy behavior. Do not change Disengage status or suppression rules, targeting, execution routing, or native Lancer behavior.
acceptance_criteria: runActionEconomyPreValidationHook recognizes a matching unexecuted Turn action from the prepared authoritative snapshot.
A matching prepared request is rebuilt with the existing ignoreActionCost mechanism and revalidated against the same snapshot.
The hook retains that ignore-cost request for the existing later action-economy commit path, preventing a second action-cost mutation.
Without a matching unexecuted committed action, the prepared request and validation are unchanged.
Committed full.disengage is no longer blocked or falsely failed because its Full Action was already recorded.
Disengage status, suppression, targeting, execution routing, native Lancer behavior, and genuine failure behavior remain unchanged.
non_goals: Change action costs or turn limits.
Change Disengage duration or suppression semantics.
Refactor the execution transaction runner or unrelated action execution.
